settings.headline: Roasted with intention, not automation
settings.body:
Every batch begins with green coffee selected from farms we know by name. We roast on a vintage Probat drum roaster, where heat, airflow, and time are adjusted by hand for each origin.

No shortcuts. No dark roasts hiding defects. Just coffee that tastes like where it came from.
